title: T1496.003 — Resource Hijacking - SMS Pumping
subtitle: This simulation shows a complete SMS pumping attack on an app with an OTP form.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Leasing a number range
steps.caption: A fraud ring leases a block of phone numbers in countries where SMS termination fees are high. Every message delivered to those numbers pays the ring a share of the fee. This step happens in the telecom market, so the victim sees nothing yet
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Studying the signup flow
steps.caption: The fraudster finds a public signup page and confirms that any phone number triggers a verification SMS. No account is needed. Web logs show a handful of OTP requests from one new ASN (Autonomous System Number - the network that owns the IP addresses), which looks like ordinary noise
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.
